title: 第2321章 你真狗 真够阴险第2320章 三十六计 走为上计
content_zh:
“呵呵，这家伙不是师尊的对手，要逃了！师娘我们要不要出手？”
吴曦枬看出魔帝要逃，当即询问景儿。
“召唤三道分身，准备强攻撤离，魔帝想多了，你师尊的分身还少吗？”
景儿清楚郑风有万余道灵魂分身。魔帝弄出来三道分身，这不是班门弄斧！
“放心吧，大哥绝不会放他走！”
郑杰信誓旦旦，盯着高空中战斗正酣的郑风分身和魔帝以及三道分身，一点没有压力。
吴曦枬见师尊分身以一敌四，正欲上去帮忙，被景儿拉住了。
“枬儿，你师尊就在万丈虚空之上，他这道分身真若不敌，定会释放更多分身出来，别添乱，说不好你师尊想要检测一下分身的战力极限。”
景儿一脸沉稳，眼神中对郑风的信任与支持无比坚定。看魔帝的眼神甚至有几分怜悯。
“风哥哥本尊还没出现，万余道灵魂分身还深藏不露，比分身数量和等级魔帝都是完败。”
魔帝和郑风分身的战斗终于扭转了局面。
郑风分身以一敌四还是有些力不从心。尽管有陨神诀、金龙炼体诀、灵魂观想法三驾马车联袂运行，更有吞天大阵加持，奈何魔帝修为在那里摆着，仅有魔帝本尊时，郑风分身能做到轻松对战，可随着魔帝三道分身联手后，一改颓势，局面逆转。
“呵呵，别装了，明明就是一个小崽子，非要幻化为老者模样，之前不是吞噬得很爽吗？”
有一种报复性的快感，令魔帝从压抑憋屈中得到释然。魔帝本尊和三道分身异口同声地吼道：“本帝一口恶气呼出，神清气爽啊！”
郑风分身被魔帝压着打，腾挪辗转，由攻转为防守。憋屈已久的心情无比激动，翻身农奴把歌唱的喜悦，脸上的笑容绽放，人也没有之前那么狰狞了。
“呵呵，真把你爽呆了！”
郑风分身快速闪动，以防御为主，看似狼狈，却并未受伤。青龙族空间神通修行至今，效果很明显，魔帝本尊和三道分身追着郑风一道分身打，居然没有造成实质上的伤害。
景儿看得清清楚楚，明明白白，对于郑风刻意为之，心有灵犀。
“这样高强度的博弈，机会难得只是这种情况风哥哥应对起来驾轻就熟，仅仅只是一道分身就拖住了魔帝和他三道分身，还并未吃亏。风哥哥本尊的战斗力强到了何种地步？”
心里暗自揣摩，景儿妹妹为之欣喜。

四打一都没有占到便宜，魔帝心头的失落感再次涌上心头。
“啊！啊！啊！有种你就和本帝大战一场，老是躲，是怎么回事？”
听魔帝恬不知耻的言论，郑风分身笑了，笑得有些讥讽。
“你他妈的是个人吗？活了上千年的老怪，和几十岁的毛头小子打架，本尊打斗也就罢了，居然还传唤三道分身，玩群殴，你还有脸了？”
破口大骂，郑风纵算是好脾气，也对魔帝厚颜无耻的要求嗤之以鼻。
“真他妈脑壳进水了！这样的无理要求也敢在众目睽睽之下大声说出来！”
“不要脸，不要皮呗！”
“其实他本就不是人，既不是好人，也不是坏人，最多算个有些人模狗样的魔。”
天团少年各队队长为郑风鸣不平，群起而攻之，带动了其他势力的武者支持。
围观武者只当天团少年出自人族势力，在和魔人作战的时候，同为人族，应同仇敌忾，该支持谁？拎得清！
content_en:
"Haha, this guy is no match for Master and is trying to escape! Master, should we take action?"
Wu Xizhen saw that the Demon Emperor was trying to escape and immediately asked Jing'er.
"Summon three clones and prepare to attack and evacuate. The Demon Emperor is overthinking. Do you still have few clones of your master?"
Jing'er knew that Zheng Feng had more than ten thousand soul clones. The Demon Emperor created three clones, this is no ordinary trick!
"Don't worry, big brother will never let him go!"
Zheng Jie swore firmly and stared at Zheng Feng's clone, the Demon Emperor and the three clones who were fighting in the sky, feeling no pressure at all.
Wu Xizhen saw his master's clones fighting one against four, and was about to go up to help, but was pulled back by Jing'er.
"Zhe'er, your master is above the void. If his clone is really defeated, more clones will be released. Don't cause trouble. Maybe your master wants to test the limit of the clone's combat power."
Jing'er's face was calm, and her trust and support for Zheng Feng in her eyes were extremely firm. There was even a hint of pity in the Demon Emperor's eyes.
"Brother Feng's true form has not yet appeared, and more than ten thousand soul clones are still hidden. Compared with the number of clones and the level of the Demon Emperor, they are completely defeated."
The battle between the Demon Emperor and Zheng Feng's clone finally turned the situation around.
Zheng Feng's clone was still a little weak against one against four. Although there are the troika of Meteor God Technique, Golden Dragon Body Refining Technique, and Soul Concept Method running hand in hand, as well as the blessing of the Sky Swallowing Formation, the Demon Emperor's cultivation is there. When there is only the Demon Emperor himself, Zheng Feng's clone can easily fight, but with the three clones of the Demon Emperor joining forces, the decline has changed and the situation has been reversed.
"Haha, stop pretending. He's obviously just a little brat, but he insists on transforming into an old man. Didn't he enjoy eating it before?"
There was a sense of revenge that made the Demon Emperor feel relieved from his depression and frustration. The Demon Emperor himself and the three clones shouted in unison: "This emperor exhaled a breath of evil breath, feeling refreshed and refreshed!"
Zheng Feng's clone was suppressed and beaten by the Demon Emperor. He moved around, switching from attack to defense. The mood that had been suppressed for a long time was extremely exciting. The serfs turned over and sang with joy. The smiles on their faces bloomed, and they were no longer as ferocious as before.
"Haha, I really am so happy for you!"
Zheng Feng's clone flashed quickly, focusing on defense. He looked embarrassed, but was not injured. The Qinglong Clan's spatial magical power practice has been very effective so far. The Demon Emperor himself and three clones chased Zheng Feng and fought one clone at a time, but no actual damage was caused.
Jing'er could see it clearly, clearly, and had a clear understanding of what Zheng Feng did deliberately.
"Such a high-intensity game is a rare opportunity. It's just that Brother Feng is very familiar with this situation. Just one clone was able to hold back the Demon Emperor and three of his clones without suffering a loss. How strong is Brother Feng's fighting power?"
She secretly thought about it in her heart, and Sister Jing'er was happy about it.
Four against one failed to gain any advantage, and the feeling of loss in the Demon Emperor's heart surged into his heart again.
"Ah! Ah! Ah! If you have the guts, fight with me. Why are you always hiding?"
Hearing Demon Emperor Tian's shameless remarks, Zheng Feng's clone laughed, a bit sarcastically.
"Are you a fucking human being? An old monster who has lived for thousands of years, fights with a young boy who is decades old. It's just a fight with himself, but he actually summons three clones to engage in group fights. Do you still have the face?"
Swearing loudly, Zheng Feng, even though he had a good temper, sneered at the Demon Emperor's shameless request.
"My fucking head is wet! How dare you say such an unreasonable request loudly in public!"
"Shameless, shameless!"
"Actually, he is not a human being at all. He is neither a good person nor a bad person. At most, he is a demon who looks like a human being."
The captains of the various Tiantuan youth teams were aggrieved by Zheng Fengming and attacked him in groups, attracting support from warriors from other forces.
The onlookers who watched the warriors only saw that the boy from Tiantuan came from the human race. When fighting the demons, they were both human race and shared the same hatred. Who should they support? Can carry it clearly!
